correctness.rationale: The GHM map is exactly global rotation except at a single excited vertex whose matched partner is resting, or when no excited vertex exists. At each defect, the numbers r,s of other resting/refractory vertices satisfy r+s=2m-2>=4; the four cases r=0, s=0, r>=2 and s>=1, and r=1 and s>=3 cover every possibility and explicitly enter extinction or a pure three-cycle. The three singular-color exclusions in the surjective-color count are pairwise disjoint and each has size n(2^(n-2)-1). Every orbit of least period three contributes three states. Full direct-neighbor functional-graph enumeration of 597870 labelled configurations for n=2,4,6,8,10,12 reproduces all counts; finite experiments are not used as the infinite proof. The n=4 exception is a fully enumerated finite graph.

value.rationale: The family is the natural complete graph with one perfect matching deleted. The theorem gives a complete all-size recurrent classification, an exact exponential-scale primitive-orbit census, a sharp four-to-three period transition between the 4-vertex and 6-vertex instances, and the asymptotic fraction of immediately periodic configurations. Those structural facts are not elementary renamings or isolated small-parameter computations, and are motivated by how excitable dynamics responds to a systematic minimal nonneighbor pattern.
